title: FinalizationRegistryObject::unregister can read arguments out of bound when no arguments are supplied
bug_discussion:
Bugzilla report: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1987290

Created attachment 9511856
poc.js

This code snippet causes the JS shell to crash on Nightly:

```js
const v = new FinalizationRegistry(() => {});
v.unregister();
```

This is regressed by Bug 1863140 [Part 3 (D263113)](https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D263113), where a `args[0]` is used to get an element rather than `args.get(0)` at <https://searchfox.org/firefox-main/rev/f985f336deeb9f7cb63d43c4f8dc8612d27b79e4/js/src/builtin/FinalizationRegistryObject.cpp#592>.
